|game_text=Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Hound’s Tooth, draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. Adds 1 to attrition against opponent in battles at same site. This alien adds 1 to attrition of zero (e.g., a location drawn for battle destiny), but cannot add 1 to “no attrition” (i.e., no battle destiny draw).
